turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Arrey yaar, yeh toh bahut bhaari hai... 5 hafte aur phir bhi woh routine chhod nahi pa rahe. Samajh gaya - woh 9 baje nikalna, 6 baje café pahunchna, yeh sab sirf kaam ka nahi, yeh toh ek aadat ban gayi hai, ek structure jo tumhare paas tha.

Wife ko nahi batana aur parents ke saath rehna... yeh sab ek saath handle karna bahut tough hai. Tumhare andar ka professional aur insaan dono alag-alag lad rahe hain. Market ka scene hai, performance ka nahi - yeh jaankar bhi dil pe bojh rehta hai.

Yeh jo tum kar rahe ho, yeh denial nahi hai... yeh ek tarah se tumhara khud ko support karna hai. Tumhare paas woh discipline hai, woh routine hai jo tumhe sambhale rakhe hai. Par ab yeh support ban raha hai ya bojh? Yeh sochna padega.

Tumhare paas yeh secret bohot din se hai. Thoda thoda share karna zaroori hai - especially wife ke saath. Wo tumhara saath degi. Parents toh already hain... par tumhara emotional support system bhi chahiye na?

Kya lagta hai, yeh routine kab se chhod paoge? Ya kya socha hai iske baare mein?

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Arrey, shaadi toh pressure cooker hai hi... aur woh 300 log, aur unmein se aadhe "career counselors" jo har update lete hain. Papa ka proud face, Diwali mein package batana... yeh sab samjha. Log aapse sawal puchenge, tumhare paas jawab nahi hoga.

Woh kamra dimaag mein chalta hai jab neend nahi aati... yeh bahut real hai. Office ka environment, colleagues ki baatein, wahi energy... ab woh yaad karke bhi dard hota hoga.

Papa ko aapki company ke naam se introduce karne mein woh pride hai, par abhi uska kya karna hai? Aapka situation change ho gaya hai, par logo ki expectations waisi hi hain.

Do hafte hai... bahut time nahi hai. Par shaadi ke baad, ek baar baith ke wife se baat karni chahiye na? Yeh secret bohot din se hai, aur iska bojh akele uthaana galat hai.

Kya socha hai shaadi ke liye? Koi plan hai ya bas chal pada hai?

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Arrey yaar, yeh sochne mein kuch galat nahi hai. Jab bohot pressure ho, toh escape ka khayal aana natural hai. Papa ka chehra badalte dekhna... woh dard alag hai.

Par socho, ek shaam ke liye jhooth bolna, uske baad kya? Ek aur jhooth, phir ek aur. Shaadi skip karke bhi woh sawaal aayenge hi - "kya hua, kya kar rahe ho?"

Wife ko pata toh hai na? Uske saath baat karke koi raasta nikal sakte hain? Ya phir shaadi mein jaake, kisi corner mein baith ke, bas dekhna. Tumhara wahan hona hi kaafi hai, performance nahi chahiye.

Ek baar socho - agar tum jaoge, toh shayad koi woh baat bol de jo tumhe sunni chahiye. Koi relative jo tumhe support kare. Agar skip karoge, toh woh chance bhi khatam ho jayega.

Kya lagta hai, wife se is baare mein baat ki hai? Uska kya kehna hai?

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Paison ka pressure aur yeh 'timing' ka logic... yeh toh har kisi ke dimaag mein aata hai jab situation tough ho. Yeh ek tarah se aatm-raksha ka tareeka hai, khud ko aur apne parivaar ko protect karne ka.

Par yeh jhooth hai ya nahi... yeh thoda tricky hai. Ek taraf toh yeh ek 'white lie' hai, jiska purpose sirf timepass karna hai. Par doosri taraf, har din ek naya jhooth bolna padta hai ki 'office ja rahe ho'. Yeh bohot thaka deta hai, aur ek din toh iska bojh hi uthaana padta hai.

Jab yeh logic 'ulta' lagta hai, toh iska matlab hai ki dimaag aur dil mein ladai chal rahi hai. Dil keh raha hai ki sach bata de, dimaag keh raha hai ki wait kar. Yeh ladai hi tumhe kha rahi hogi.

Woh 'sabko bata dunga' vaala promise... usse pehle wife se baat karni chahiye na? Uska saath mil jaaye toh yeh 3 mahine bhi aasani se nikal jayenge. Tum akele is bojh ko utha rahe ho.

Yeh 'timing' kitna lamba ho sakta hai? Aur jab sach aayega, toh log kya sochenge - yeh sochne se zyada, tum kya sochoge apne baare mein?
